The busy look moves from `disabled:opacity-50` to `aria-disabled:opacity-50`, so it reads the same.
- **Tests (dev):** `ledgerSwitch-28148` 12 / 12 and `customizeFlow-28570` 10 / 10 at this head. Ablation 1 (back to `disabled` while busy) reds 2 at `document.activeElement`; ablation 2 (guard dropped) reds 2 at the request count; both restored, blob equal to HEAD. Derived gates 34 of 34 at 951c8599, 31 re-run green here; type-check, eslint and body gates green.
- **Measured (dev):** live in Chromium 153 on a fresh showcase: on `main` focus goes to `<body>` in flight and after, for an accepted and a 409 toggle; on this branch it stays on the switch, one request per leg.
- **Gates (check-runs on this head):** 44 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state` is clean.
